Apr 22, 2025 — Bracket City, a word puzzle that tasks players with solving nested clues — embedded in the titular brackets.
AI Overview
Bracket City is a daily word and trivia game hosted by The Atlantic. 
How It Works
Nested Clues: Players solve a series of layered, bracketed clues scattered throughout a text passage or sentence.
Chain Reactions: Solving one bracket expands it to reveal a new clue or word hidden inside, gradually building the complete sentence.
Historical Facts: Each completed puzzle resolves into a fun fact or story about a specific day in history.
City Ranks: Players earn thematic titles based on their performance, such as "Commuter," "Mayor," or "Kingmaker" for a flawless solve. 
Playlin
 +2
Game History
Creator: Created by independent game designer Ben Gross, who originally conceptualized the nested puzzle format on paper placemats for puzzle nights at Montague Diner in Brooklyn Heights.
Launch: Acquired and launched by The Atlantic in April 2025 alongside other daily puzzle offerings.
